title: HYDRA on Radix DLT: Five Live Products, Zero VC Money, and a Burn That Never Stops
excerpt: Launched February 8, 2026, HYDRA already ships five live products — HydraSwap, HydraBurn, HydraBubbles, HydraBattleArena, HydraTrack — with zero VC money and 100,000 tokens burned every week.
content:
## What Is HYDRA?

HYDRA is a community-driven memecoin built natively on **Radix DLT**, one of the most technically advanced distributed ledger networks in the world. Launched on **February 8, 2026**, HYDRA was created with a single founding principle: 100% community ownership. There was no presale, no team allocation, no venture capital. Every token has always belonged to the community.

In a market crowded with projects that promise the world and deliver nothing, HYDRA stands out for a different reason. It is building a real, functioning ecosystem — and doing it transparently, on-chain, on Radix.

## Tokenomics Built for Scarcity

Understanding HYDRA starts with its tokenomics, which are refreshingly straightforward. The total supply created was **1,000,000,000 HYDRA** — one billion tokens. Of those, approximately **965,600,000 HYDRA** are currently in circulation. The difference represents tokens already removed from existence through the project's core mechanic: the weekly burn.

Every single week, **100,000 HYDRA tokens are permanently burned** — sent to a dead address with no way back. There is no complex governance vote, no quarterly decision. It simply happens, on-chain, every week. At this rate, the project removes over **5,200,000 tokens from circulation every year**. That is not a promise or a whitepaper projection. That is math executing itself publicly on the Radix ledger.

The distribution is equally clean: **100% community**. No team wallet quietly dumping tokens. No VC allocation waiting to exit.

## Why Radix DLT?

Most memecoins launch on Ethereum, Solana, or BNB Chain because those are the easiest paths. HYDRA chose **Radix DLT** — and that choice reflects a different kind of ambition. Radix is built from the ground up for decentralized finance. Its asset-oriented programming model treats tokens as first-class citizens of the protocol, not smart contract workarounds prone to bugs and exploits.

## A Live Ecosystem, Not a Roadmap

This is where HYDRA separates itself from the majority of memecoins. Every product in the HYDRA ecosystem is **already live and operational**.

**[HydraSwap](https://hydraxrd.com/swap)** is the decentralized exchange where HYDRA is traded. **HydraBurn** executes the weekly 100,000 token burn. **HydraBubbles**, **HydraBattleArena**, and **HydraTrack** round out the ecosystem. Five products. All running. All built on Radix. That level of execution from a community memecoin less than a year old is genuinely rare.

## A Small Community With Real Conviction

HYDRA is honest about where it stands. This is an **early-stage community project**. The Telegram has around **120 members**. The [X account](https://x.com/hydraxrd) has around **290 followers**. These numbers are small by the standards of the memecoin market — but they represent a real community that understands what it holds, participates in burn events, uses [HydraSwap](https://hydraxrd.com/swap), and engages with the ecosystem.

Every major memecoin in history started from a small, tight-knit group of true believers. The ones that survived were carried by communities with genuine conviction — and that is exactly what HYDRA is building.

## How to Buy HYDRA

Get a Radix wallet from the [Radix website](https://radixdlt.com), acquire some XRD on a major centralized exchange, then head to [HydraSwap](https://hydraxrd.com/swap) and swap your XRD for HYDRA. HYDRA is **not listed on any centralized exchange** — it trades exclusively through HydraSwap on Radix DLT.
